name: Georgina Energy PLC
summary: Georgina Energy Plc is dedicated to the exploration, development, and production of helium, hydrogen, and other natural resources. The company currently holds stakes in two primary ventures: the Hussar Project, situated in Western Australia's Officer Basin, and the EPA155 Mt Winter Project, found within the Amadeus Basin of the Northern Territory. Established on July 30, 2024, its corporate headquarters are located in London, United Kingdom.
